text:
Sam: Heads-up — got a customer report: tool/function call to 'payment-check' is failing with schema validation in prod since ~09:12 PST. Error: SchemaValidationError: additionalProperties at /params -> 'currency' not allowed. Full error copy below.

Sam: Request payload we saw:
```json
{"user_id":"acct_42","amount":1000,"currency":"USD","idempotency_key":"abc-123"}
```

Sam: The tool spec expects params: { user_id: string, amount: string, idempotency_key: string } — note amount should be string.

Maria: Oof. Is this from hosted API or Dedicated customer?
Sam: Hosted (api.redwood.ai) from customer corp-omega, started after SDK 0.9.2 upgrade.

Alex: Can you paste the exact validation error/stack and request id?
Sam: Error dump:
```txt
SchemaValidationError: additionalProperties 'currency' not allowed at /params
  at validate (/srv/runtime/validator.js:45:15)
  at handleToolCall (/srv/runtime/handler.js:220:10)
Request-ID: req_0x9f73ab
Trace: payment-check#invoke -> validator
```

Jess: Two problems: (1) additionalProperties flagged — validator uses "additionalProperties: false" in tool schema; (2) amount type mismatch: schema expects string but SDK now sends number. Likely SDK change.

Maria: Repro steps to triage? we've got customer on the line.
Sam: Repro steps I used:
1) curl POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/call -H 'Authorization: Bearer x' -d '{...payload above...}'
2) Observe 400 with SchemaValidationError

Alex: Short-term mitigation: Gateway can strip unknown keys before validator. Could add a compatibility shim for amount numeric->string. Ops, we should consider automatic coercion.
Jess: I'd rather update tool manifest to allow additionalProperties: true for payment-check or explicitly add 'currency' optional string. Which is safer?

Maria: Customer urgent. What's ETA for a hotfix?
Alex: I can push gateway shim to strip unknown keys in 30-45m behind a feature flag.
Jess: I'll prepare a small schema patch to accept amount:number|string and optional currency.

Sam: Ticket created: SUPPORT-5421. Noted customer ID and contact.
support-bot: Incident SUPPORT-5421 created and linked to ticketing system — priority P1 :rotating_light:

Maria: Please include regression test and note SDK version 0.9.2 in the ticket.
Alex: Will push shim + rollback plan. Will ping when up :eyes: 
Jess: After schema patch I'll run evals on canary and then roll.

Sam: Thanks. I'll inform customer and request logs for any other toolcalls with extra keys.
Maria: Great, keep updates in this thread.
